riki_backstab.name: Backstab
riki_backstab.description: When attacking from behind, the hero deals additional damage based on agility.
riki_backstab.note0: When last-hitting allied units, it works at %ally_multiplier%%% effectiveness.
riki_backstab.note1: Illusions also have backstab attack animation, but they deal no bonus damage.

riki_smoke_screen.name: Smoke Screen
riki_smoke_screen.description: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
riki_smoke_screen.lore: The Silent Assassin highly values a simple smoke screen that confuses his enemies, for on a fateful night it saved him from traitors.
riki_smoke_screen.note0: Can be used while under Tricks of the Trade.
riki_smoke_screen.shard_description: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by %armor_reduction% and cannot be targeted by their allies.

riki_blink_strike.name: Blink Strike
riki_blink_strike.description: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by %slow_pct_tooltip%%% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.
riki_blink_strike.lore: No one escapes the nimble assassin.
riki_blink_strike.note2: This ability can be used on allies, and they will not take damage.
riki_blink_strike.note0: The first attack after using this ability will be made from behind.
riki_blink_strike.note1: The ability’s damage is applied before the next attack.

riki_tricks_of_the_trade.name: Tricks of the Trade
riki_tricks_of_the_trade.description: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes %interval_targets% random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
riki_tricks_of_the_trade.note1: Backstab damage is applied to all units hit.
riki_tricks_of_the_trade.facet_riki_exterminator: Tricks of the Trade has %creep_agility_multiplier%x Agility Bonus when attacking non-hero units. When Riki kills a non-hero unit during Tricks of the Trade, the cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%s.
riki_tricks_of_the_trade.scepter_description: Increases Cast Range to %AbilityCastRange%. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have %scepter_movespeed%%% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts %scepter_bonus_duration%s longer and does an additional %scepter_bonus_attacks% attacks.
riki_tricks_of_the_trade.lore: The stealthy assassin believes that in battle, all means are fair, and does not hesitate to strike from behind.

riki_permanent_invisibility.name: Cloak and Dagger
riki_permanent_invisibility.description: The hero merges with the shadows, remaining barely visible until he attacks or approaches an enemy hero too quickly. Participating in kills grants additional experience.
